name: Pipeliners - Blog Clusters 2026-07
body:
> Blog · Pipeliners · 2026-07-21

# Summary
Rollup of `blog-clusters-2026-07\`, the July monsoon cluster work folder.

# Files
- `Pipeliners_July_Monsoon_Cluster_4_Supporting_Posts.md`: see [Pipeliners - Blog - Monsoon Cluster Supporting Posts](lib:brain-pipeliners-blog-monsoon-cluster-supporting-posts).
- `Pipeliners_Monsoon_Pillar_Refresh.md`: see [Pipeliners - Blog - Monsoon Pillar Refresh](lib:brain-pipeliners-blog-monsoon-pillar-refresh).
- `Pipeliners_Blog_Inventory_LIVE.xlsx`: every Pipeliners blog post pulled 2026-07-21 (ID, title, URL, primary focus keyword, Rank Math focus field, categories, published and modified dates, status). Summary: 54 published, 1 draft.
- `Pipeliners_Blog_List_Indexed.xlsx`: the same list with publish date, primary keyword, category and an "Indexed?" column (the July 14 posts showed Yes).

# Use
The July inventory is a useful snapshot of which posts existed before the August-October merges and rewrites (for example it shows the 6 posts from June 23, the monsoon set from July 14, and older posts such as /what-is-cipp/ 14690 and the two myths posts). For current status use the Website Pages tracker.
